auditor_value: a(m₂) = 2g(2η − sinθ)/(1 + 4η), downward when 2η > sinθ (m₁ moves up the incline with half this magnitude; wedge taken as fixed)
question_defect: The question never says the wedge is fixed and says no surface has friction, yet gives no wedge mass; the only workable reading is a wedge that stays at rest, which the solution assumes without saying so. Standard for this problem type, so not filed against the solution.
notes: Constraint a₂ = 2a₁, pulley balance T₁ = 2T₂, both force equations and the algebra a₁(1+4η) = g(2η − sinθ) all check; the common-mistakes entry's wrong denominator (1+2η) does follow from a₂ = a₁ with T₁ = 2T₂ kept. Final answer agrees with mine.
